title: Convenient Chipping Modpack
description: A modpack that combines the Chipped mod with world generation, storage, immersion, and quality of life mods designed to make play-throughs focused on building with Chipped more convenient and immersive.
body:
This simple NeoForge mod pack includes world generation, storage, immersion, and quality of life mods that pair well with the Chipped mod. If you want a playthrough focused on building with Chipped, but don't want to miss out on other essential mods, this modpack is for you.

# Features
**Building with Chipped**

1000's of unique building block variations

**An Avant Garde World**

Grander landscape generation and new biomes to explore

**Better Item Storage**

Improved storage options and backpacks for a better solution to carrying items

**Real Immersion**

Shader support, realistic sound physics, female gender model support, and a true-to-life farming & cooking expansion

**QOL Extras**

Zoom-in, world map, customizable F3 modules, fixed borderless window mode, and sodium & lithium optimization

# Mods
- Athena
- BetterF3
- Chipped
- Cloth Config
- Cubes Without Borders
- Farmer's Delight
- Female Gender Mod
